cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Remember calling the spare chair unnecessary before giving its place to the cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then the guest sat on the piano stool, and you moved the pianist to the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until we open that window to cool the cake. Every sensible decision is now sitting on the next one.
